build.beforeBuildCommand: npm run build && npm run tauri:prepare

security.csp: default-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' http://127.0.0.1:8787 ipc: http://ipc.localhost; img-src 'self' data: blob: asset: http://asset.localhost; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com; font-src 'self' data: https://fonts.gstatic.com

bundle.shortDescription: Private, local audio transcription and meeting minutes.
bundle.longDescription: Turns long recordings into editable timestamped transcripts and meeting-minutes summaries. Audio never leaves this computer except for the chunks sent to OpenAI for transcription.
